newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond cuts 3 executive slots.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond cuts 3 executive slots.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said Tuesday it is cutting three positions from its management executive committee.
It said executive vice presidents Pat Guarino and Bob Mehall will be leaving August 1, and that senior vice president of marketing A.W. "Ed" O'Donnell retired May 31.

The company also said that the merger of Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock is realizing greater than anticipated savings and synergies and that it hoped the elimination of the posts would help cut costs and enhance decision-making and strategy.
The company said the responsibilities of the positions are being assigned to other senior executive team members.
